ats.summary: Technical writer with four years in dedicated documentation roles at MongoDB (contract) and Magna International, and earlier documentation work as a business analyst. Procedures, knowledge-base articles and troubleshooting guides for identity, access and security workflows, tested against the product before publication. Independent projects add API references, a GraphQL guide and a docs-as-code pipeline with Git, MDX, Docusaurus and Vale.

Identity and access
authentication, MFA, access requests, provisioning and deprovisioning, written for administrators and end users
Review and lifecycle

Visual explanation
annotated screenshots, short GIFs, captioned screen recordings and diagrams
